releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.98 redesigns Files > Category > My Categories using the approved circular icon layout. Categories are shown in a clean three-column grid with a large pastel circle, a colored category icon, the category name below it, and the file count underneath. Long names can use two centered lines at a normal readable size instead of shrinking the whole title. Manage, category navigation, counts, Search behavior, multi-select, Add to Category, permanent delete, Scan New Document and all stored data remain unchanged.
